bns:Component.name: Send_TransactionLog_Insert_V2
bns:Component.bns:description: Database V2 Dynamic Insert into EDV_INTEGRATION.TRANSACTION_LOG (SQL Server). All 10 columns are bound via "? AS [name]" sub-select parameters - Dynamic Insert cannot mix literal SQL expressions (NEWID(), SYSUTCDATETIME()) with parameterized columns (confirmed empirically: unbound columns insert as NULL). TRANSACTION_ID is a client-generated UUID (Sub_Generate_CorrelationId's Data Process Custom Scripting step - Boomi has no native GUID generator, deliberate one-script exception per project decision 2026-09-25). Reread by Get_TransactionLog_SelectIdByCorrelation_V2 is now redundant for TransactionId (Boomi already generated it) but still confirms the row landed; kept for now.

field.value: INSERT INTO EDV_INTEGRATION.TRANSACTION_LOG (TRANSACTION_ID, CORRELATION_ID, INTERFACE_ID, OBJECT_TYPE, BUSINESS_KEY, SOURCE_SYSTEM, TARGET_SYSTEM, STATUS, START_DATE, ENVIRONMENT) SELECT transaction_id, correlation_id, interface_id, object_type, business_key, source_system, target_system, status, start_date, environment FROM (SELECT ? AS transaction_id, ? AS correlation_id, ? AS interface_id, ? AS object_type, ? AS business_key, ? AS source_system, ? AS target_system, ? AS status, ? AS start_date, ? AS environment) AS S
